Google celebrates Bangladesh Independence Day
2015-03-26T10:36:00+06:00 | Star Online Report
https://www.thedailystar.net/top-news/google-celebrates-bangladesh-independence-day-73890

Click open your Google search engine , and don’t be surprised! It is the Independence Day of Bangladesh today.

Honouring the 45th Independence Day of Bangladesh, the most popular search engine, Google, has outlaid its cover page with green and red portraying the essence of the country’s independence.

The nation is observing the day with due solemnity and respect commemorating the historic Liberation War in 1971 that gave birth to the Independent Bangladesh.

As Bangladesh is wrapped in festive fervor, why should Google be left behind?

Internet users of Bangladesh will be greeted by the colorful doodle by Google for this special day.
